name: spatial-tools
description: Thin, keyless client of the gods-eye-view spatial-intelligence service: four read-only GET tools (spatial_status, spatial_events, spatial_contacts, spatial_cameras) over the service's already-normalized JSON routes. Config carries the service base URL; no key, no GEV code and no hardcoded URL lives here.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running gods-eye-view service, e.g. 'http://gods-eye-view:4173'. REQUIRED - there is no default and the plugin refuses to register without it.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request upstream timeout in ms (default 45000, clamped to 1000..120000). Live upstreams can be slow; the service caches per source.

maxTraceContacts.description: Cap on the per-aircraft /api/opensky-track lookups a trace=true contacts call makes (default 3).
